$doc: The Earth's picture, the earth layer's source: NASA's Blue Marble Next
Generation, July 2004, by day, and the Black Marble's lights of 2016 by
night, in NASA's tiling, a row a half of the world from the north and a
column a quarter from 180° W. `deno task download earth` (pxl-tool
bin/download_earth.rs) fetches each into raw/; `deno task bake earth`
(pxl-geo-bake bin/bake_earth.rs) reads them there, by the URL's last segment.
Credit: NASA's Earth Observatory (Reto Stöckli; Miguel Román and the Black
